hero.headline: Full-stack developer building modern web applications

about.heading: About Me
about.biography: I'm a software developer on a constant learning road. Graduated in Information Systems from Estácio de Sá University, with over {{years}} years of experience in software development and a focus on full-stack development, working on innovative projects with technologies such as React, Angular, Node.js, C#, .NET Core and JavaScript.

experience.summary: Working on the development and improvement of the product for a major strategic partner, focusing on building modern and responsive interfaces as well as enhancing existing features.
highlights: Bug fixing and maintenance of existing features to ensure system stability and reliability.
Implementing a new audience matching functionality across multiple regions.
Developing unit and integration tests using Cypress and Jest to guarantee code quality and system robustness.
Working with modern technologies such as Node.js, Docker, Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, Kibana and RabbitMQ to build and maintain distributed, high-performance applications.

experience.summary: Fullstack development for industry clients, working mainly on Angular front ends integrated with .NET back ends and maintaining legacy systems across the Sotreq and Hydro projects.

projects.name: Sotreq
projects.description: Focused on front-end development, creating new features and integrating with REST APIs. Also worked on a legacy project, fixing bugs and migrating integrations to new APIs under development. Used the BFF pattern for the back end and Angular 14+ for the front end.

projects.name: Hydro
projects.description: Fullstack development for a legacy project, creating new endpoints and improving charts from a web API with vanilla JavaScript.

experience.summary: Developed improvements and new features for client products, focusing on system integrations, external API consumption and legacy system maintenance.
highlights: Developing new features for our products

experience.summary: Fullstack development with React and C#, contributing to features, code quality and team growth, including the PrevisIA environmental monitoring platform.
highlights: Front-end and back-end feature development using React and C#
Customer meetings to refine and align development

projects.name: PrevisIA
projects.description: AI platform to monitor deforestation in the Amazon biome, sponsored by Microsoft AI for Earth, Imazon and Fundo Vale. Static front-end development using HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer and Information Systems
